candidates.name: Gorlin syndrome
support_spans: multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules located on the face and vulva
Family history was notable for a daughter with similar facial papules
contradict_spans: No palmar or plantar pits were observed
candidates.why: The presence of multiple dome-shaped papules on the face and vulva, along with a family history of similar lesions, suggests a diagnosis of Gorlin syndrome.

candidates.name: infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma
support_spans: buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
candidates.why: The histopathological features of the lesions are consistent with infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma.

candidates.name: Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome
support_spans: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
candidates.why: The presence of a SUFU gene mutation suggests a diagnosis of Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, which is caused by mutations in the SUFU gene.
